definitions.gloss: exterior material; cladding material; facade material
definitions.explanation: Materials used for the outer surface of a building, such as siding, tiles, stone, or panels. These materials protect the structure from weather while also determining its visual appearance.

examples.japanese: {外装材|がいそうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Choose the color of the exterior material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{外装材|がいそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to use highly durable exterior materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{外装材|がいそうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}がれた→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: Part of the exterior cladding came off in the typhoon, so we asked a contractor to repair it.

notes:
A construction term composed of ⟦{外装|がいそう}→外装：18662_gaisou⟧ (exterior finish) and ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). Common exterior materials in Japan include ⟦サイディング→サイディング：29717_saidingu⟧ (siding panels), ⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧ (tiles), {漆喰|しっくい} (plaster), and {板張|いたば}り (wood cladding).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外装材|がいそうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{張|は}り{替|か}え: replacing exterior cladding
- {外装材|がいそうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選定|せんてい}→選定：14452_sentei⟧: selection of exterior materials
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧{外装材|がいそうざい}: metal cladding
- {外装材|がいそうざい}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: exterior material manufacturer

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧: exterior wall — the wall itself, not just the surface material
- ⟦{内装材|ないそうざい}→内装材：29250_naisouzai⟧: interior material — the counterpart for indoor finishes
- ⟦{外装|がいそう}→外装：18662_gaisou⟧: exterior finish — the broader concept including design and construction
